automationNotes: Payload Format appears only when Delivery Protocol is HTTP (DOM: edit-log-target.html); gRPC setup modal omits it — see data/dom/Launch/settings/set-up-log-target.html vs edit HTML. Flow switches to HTTP so Payload Format can be verified and the select exercised. Continue Setup, Test Connection, and Save Log Target are explicitly verified before clicks. Edit doc: after create/save, verify Log Targets route + table, then row ⋮ → Edit → Save Changes. Then Verify Connection (⋮) with Test Connection + Cancel, then Enable (toggle → Verify modal → Test Connection → Enable Log Target). Test Connection / Enable require a reachable OTLP endpoint in some orgs — failures are execution errors. Delete confirms via data-testid log-target-delete-button (delete-log-target.html). Assumes empty Log Targets list at start.
